newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany congratulates Clinton on election victory.
newsitem.headline: Germany congratulates Clinton on election victory.

text.p: German President Roman Herzog sent a telegram of congratulations to re-elected U.S. President Bill Clinton on Wednesday and said he hoped the close cooperation between their countries would continue.
"I send my congratulations to you in the name of the German people," Herzog said. "Together our nations are facing great challenges that can be mastered only by working together."
Herzog said that the continued close ties between Germany and the United States were vital for efforts to resolve international problems.
"We have faith that the strong basis of the German-American friendship will remain in tact," Herzog said.
Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel also wished Clinton well. "I congratulate Clinton for his phenomenal election victory," he told reporters in Bonn.
